description: This file defines a custom attribute class 'AuditAttribute' for ASP.NET Core MVC, used for auditing actions executed on controller methods. It captures request details and records an audit entry after the action executes.

classes.name: AuditAttribute
classes.description: A custom attribute class derived from ActionFilterAttribute, used to inject auditing logic into MVC controller actions.

methods.name: OnActionExecutionAsync
methods.description: Overrides the async method called during action execution; performs auditing after the action executes.
